title: A review of the impact of formative assessment on student achievement in mathematics
venue: NOMAD Nordic Studies in Mathematics Education 22(3)
abstract: The results show positive relations between student achievement in mathematics and the ways of doing formative assessment.

summary.claim: Formative assessment approaches are positively related to mathematics achievement (journal articles 2005-2014, Web of Science).
summary.condition: Review of published studies; relations, not causal effects; no pooled effect size in abstract.
summary.gap: Does not address primary-level diagnosis tools or purchasing by tuition centres.
